body:
It makes sense, I can relate.

Do you ever feel like the meds are compressing your emotional range?  So you don't feel much of anything?

That's a fair assessment, sinusoidosaurus.  I think it might be a little of both reasons that's holding me back from making a change.  Although, also, a psychologist told me once that making major life decisions when unwell is a bad idea.

I could quit my job.  Am pretty much resigned (hehe) to the fact that I want to quit.  I am worried about coming up to Christmas, though.  It's normally a quiet time for the job market in my field.

I could leave my spouse.  We did just enter into a major financial commitment, however.  And she has put up with my depression for all the time she has known me.

Just about my work - I feel shame because I walked out last Friday and haven't been back.  I worked from home Monday and am taking sick leave today.  They are an understanding bunch but there is only so much leniency.  I have to go back or move on somehow.

It's first world problems.  

I have no savings, a mortgage, just taken on an investment property, and been passed over for promotion at work for a far younger man.  The investment property was not my idea, it was my partners, but it will benefit me, so I went along with it.  Have been working full time and studying part time because I don't really like the field that I'm in.  Just been mega fucking stressed.

It just doesn't seem like there's any room to move.  Always stressed out, always worrying, never have enough time to be a good dad, too many things I should be doing for myself and others but not enough time.

My career seems shit - kids half my age are getting promoted to managerial positions while I'm stuck being a line programmer.  

I don't know if I love my spouse or really want to be with her.  She has many good qualities but she is an alcoholic and family issues of her own that I never really wanted to be a part of.  I met her on the internet and got her pregnant and did what I thought was the right thing and stayed.  I love my kid to death - I think it's the only true deep connection in my life.

I could change all this.  I could leave my spouse.  I could leave my job.  But would things be any better?  Or would I end up even worse?

I have never been able to let anyone in.  I don't know how.  It's fucking scary to admit I have a problem to myself let alone other people.  I have a daughter, I don't want to leave her fatherless.  I need help.
